# Original-AST judgment: concrete consumer and first-program boundary

Additive non-normative follow-up to original-ast-checking-candidate-01. Neither
document is adopted. Prepared from read-only source inspection, with no build,
test, CLI or native execution. Root must freeze real first programs/outputs and
post the concrete ordinary contract before code. No Guardian act is proposed.

## One source authority, two existing output adapters

The required flow is:

```text
retained original Sources + fresh Resolution + original occurrence Index
                  |
        common whole-source judgment
                  |
 owned checked interfaces / BinderKeys / body effects / explicit obligations
              /                         \
 finite lowering eligibility       concrete selected preparation eligibility
       |                                   |
 existing finite table/native        existing Raw/hierarchy evidence/native
```

The judgment visits **every original declaration and whole body** in the
declared order, including all four registry modules. It returns no success on
a skipped form or only a checked entry dependency slice. Runtime names/types,
ordered generic kinds, static premises/access, body types/owners/capabilities,
call/decrease graph and principal effects become one source authority. Source
types use the existing common Type representation and symbolic normalized
sizes, with actual resolved Basis/operation/Meaning identities. These are
untrusted frontend facts, never accepted handles or theorem discharges.

A checked interface contains original DefId and parameter ordinals/categories,
typed runtime parameters/result, premises, formal operation bases/access and
resolved Meaning references. It does not clone body syntax. Exact finite
Meaning matrix materialization and its concrete evidence can stay at their
existing gate; the actual matrix must match the resolved typed Meaning identity
before entering finite Bindings. No interface reference is a fabricated matrix
proof. Body facts retain inferred/asserted effects and their source origins,
checked call/provider dependencies and explicit concrete obligations where
source typing is insufficient.

## Actual consumer migration

**Finite:** insert the common judgment in process_loaded_project after complete
original loading/resolution and before profile::check. Compiler's signature
lookup consumes the checked interface, with a later exact conversion to its
existing finite Type<Infallible>; that conversion is emitter eligibility, not
a second generic type/name policy. abstract_bindings consumes already checked
formal bases/access/resolved Meaning references and the actually checked finite
matrix payload, preserving its identity/depth/work metadata. Remove the old
check_generic/Lowerer abstract-placeholder pass as the authoritative generic
checker only once every rule it currently performs has a replacement. Keep
concrete Lowerer owner tracking, exact transforms/contracts, compile_basis/
compile_meaning tables, checked input/output IR and fresh native verification.
Those checks remain valuable independent output verification even where source
typing already checked the same ownership premise.

**Selected:** ParsedProgram parsing must retain complete originals without
running a semantic projection before the shared judgment. Replace declaration,
program and Checker generic policy in sized/check.rs with that same judgment;
effects and checked interfaces come from its result. Instantiate checks closed
Basis/Nat/provider arguments, exact specialization identity, premises and
aggregate capacities against these facts. Concrete elaboration still checks
its actual substitutions, dynamic fold/call instances and evidence requirements.
It must not repeat an independent generic source policy or infer approval from
an annotation. Lookup uses DefId/module/ast_index rather than name recovery.

If the **existing** private Function projection temporarily remains for
concrete elaboration, obtain it only after whole-source success and only as a
lowering representation. All original declarations/facts remain available;
record a located eligibility failure for each unsupported concrete form instead
of manufacturing a module with that declaration removed. A later request for
such a body must fail honestly. Do not add another profile AST. Retiring this
temporary projection remains a tracked #32/#317 criterion; it cannot silently
become canonical library source authority.

**Redundant source checks:** the finite generic placeholder pass, both private
declaration kind/access/name/type loops, both source-body type/access/owner
rules and their separate source effect derivations become redundant only after
real consumers use the common facts. They must be removed or demoted to actual
concrete output checks, not left as parallel entry-dependent source acceptance.
The current shared Formals/pattern/ordinary/effects helpers are reused inside
the substantive judgment. A new wrapper around their old consumers is not this
unit. **Remaining eligibility:** supported closed types/primitives/static
operations, finite/H exact coefficient domains, actual cleanup/injectivity and
contract evidence, closed provider/interface binding, capacity/work and native
version/schema/artifact checks. Common source success cannot waive any of them.

## First small program matrix

All programs use schema2/edition2026. Ordinary valid main plus private unused
definitions are intentional. Source expectations below are predictions until
the preserved first capture; no command was executed. Use one/two source qubits
and N=0,1,2,3 only for later authorized closed checks.

| Control | Desired original source content | Shared judgment | Later boundary retained |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mixed valid declaration collection | candidate quarter qif(id,s) plus private sized_identity[n] with carry-preserving fold and ordinary main()->Unit | Every finite and generic body/type/access/effect checked | Finite Nat/fold lowering may still refuse; that is distinct from source failure |
| Invalid private Nat/fold | same collection, zero fold yields (a,a) instead of a | Ownership/type error in unused fold before profile eligibility | No native call or main success can hide it |
| Dead generic missing access | private f[n,U:Op<Bits<n>>] with only Apply(U); dead static arm contains adjoint(U,q) | Actual missing Adjoint at its source use, every arm checked | Concrete provider or n=0 cannot rescue the body |
| Exact symbolic trees | forward Op<Bits<n>> before n; wrong carry tree; separate Basis-before-Natural and Natural-left/right controls | Actual ordered-kind, full Parameter scan and recursive Natural error priorities | No width coercion or eager name pre-scan |
| Ordinary basis domain | private nonzero2((a,b):(Bit,Bit))->Bit; plus xor2(x,y)/and2(x,y) as declared two-argument total maps | Correct arity/pattern/result and all call bodies checked; noninjective ordinary map is valid | Injectivity belongs to enclosing coherent lift, not ordinary predicate admission |
| Unused bad Basis body | nonzero2 declares Bit but returns (a,b), beside valid main | Exact result/tree rejection, not selected profile Unsupported | No registry/bundled-origin exception |
| qif positive/formal negative | quarter uses id/s; generic variant uses U with Controlled(U), then only Apply(U) | Existing primitive/transparent provider types and actual Controlled requirement consumed | Primitive name does not supply a new native rule |
| qif wrong provider effect/shape | arm observes or returns a different product/Unit tree | Principal effect/exact target rejection before lowering | externally unitary remains an unsupported semantic justification |
| Computed scope | correct existing nonzero2 wrapper and retained-meter/reflection definitions; wrong explicit predicate arity; prohibited quantum capture | Complete original scope/type/owner/call/effect judgments | Actual full-state exact cleanup gate remains required; never claim generic cleanup from source typing |
| All four actual bundles | unchanged fixed registry ASTs and original imports/private bodies, including toffoli/t/s/id/z/measure_z as actually used | No skipped Basis, computed or incompatible unused definition; every contract interface accounted | Emitting/executing a selected unsupported form still rejects honestly |
| Local generic Fourier | unchanged frozen licensed local transform::qft plus zero branch | Its whole generic Nat/fold/decreasing body checked independently of its name | Existing exact request/source/family obligations remain separate; no canonical std exposure |

Add text/JSON priority controls with an earlier genuine semantic error and a
later profile limitation or malformed module, retaining actual first outputs.
The semantic-before-profile migration intentionally changes some old priorities
and native invocation counts. Do not overwrite first40 or normalize those
changes as byte parity. Keep old successful small concrete outputs/proposals
where their underlying source, profile and actual output route are unchanged.

## Precise first coherent completion boundary

The unit is complete only when the same mandatory common judgment is the real
source consumer in both entry paths; all four unchanged bundles **and** the
existing generic Nat/Basis/Op/static-arm/fold family are fully source checked;
all current original finite-only source forms have actual replacement rules,
including Basis/Meaning/qif/coherent/computed/certified/operator forms; invalid
private/dead/zero bodies reject before adapter eligibility; and effect/provider
assertions derive from the completely checked call graph. Runtime If as well
as static If must retain its existing exact owner/result reconciliation.

No pre-projection rejection, unsupported-declaration omission, source-dependent
checker retry, mutable-Project cached pass or algorithm-name exception may
constitute success. Public text/JSON reports must accurately distinguish
generic/source checking, concrete eligibility and actual native evidence.
The remaining native routes must still independently reject malformed IR and
missing/incompatible kernels; checked source facts cannot authorize execution.

Record ordinary compatibility choices for the already documented static-shadow
and module-policy differences before code. This note chooses none. Their final
canonical convergence cannot be hidden in adapter flags, and any retained
temporary difference must be explicit rather than called fully unified policy.
Keep byte/parser/work/type/owner capacities and concrete error order crosswalks
tested. Require genuine current/MSRV validation, independent actual-code review
and source/policy/ledger identity checks, without new maximum cases.

Canonical std namespace migration/public generic exposure, exact qft2/qft3
correspondence and general Fourier/source/quantity proofs are subsequent
criteria, not reduced by this source unit. All24 #317 criteria and the full
#32 scope remain open; no Issue credit or new guarantee is assigned here.
